common_admission.composition: Every descendant and semantic field still needs its actual conversion/effect/numeric contract; a supported parent operation does not admit unknown nested behavior.
common_admission.qualification: Source admission, standard MLIR conversion, native legalization, complete execution and accelerator performance are distinct evidence statuses.
common_admission.resources: Finite declared domains and budgets are enforced, rather than specializing from evaluator data or silently dropping work.
common_admission.source: Native-verified pre-layout Triton v3.7.1, original operation inventory retained before normalization. Names alone do not grant types, attributes, effects or implementations.
common_admission.storage: Public tensors cover all fourteen pinned numeric types, including explicit unpacked canonical i4. Native runtime scalars retain f32/f64/i1/i8/i16/i32/i64. Explicit ValueArgument/ResultBinding v3 storage ports additionally carry exact numeric scalar/static-tile source arguments and returns through the unchanged public tensor interface, with disjoint value/state/result storage and actual guards.
common_admission.structure: Keep logical launch/tile/reuse/recurrence/control and actual effects executable. Physical placement, coalescing/cache hints and hardware mappings can remain descriptive only when values/effects do not change.

complement_rule.external_or_physical: Unknown external implementations, inline assembly, physical device/address observations and post-layout instructions require a provider or are explicit limitations.
complement_rule.invalid_source: Only a pinned native verifier failure establishes invalid source; a bad ABI is an invalid/missing contract instead.
complement_rule.missing_information: Request actual storage/shape/layout/numeric/effect facts through existing bindings, then independently validate them or emit dominating guards.
complement_rule.unmeasured: An untested typed/composition form is unmeasured; neighboring operation-name evidence is insufficient. No claim of universal Cartesian coverage follows.
complement_rule.valid_generic_failure: An unimplemented defined computation or ABI/native transport remains a generic gap; try broader standard computation and retain the exact reproducer.

assembly.admission: Optional separately selected source-language providers must emit actual standard computation with complete source, dependencies, type, packing and effect contracts; default intake refuses original inline assembly.
caller_contracts: Explicit selected semantic provider where available; source layout facts for coupled packing
assembly.complement: Unknown assembly/device observations and missing provider semantics are explicit allowed exclusions. A purity string, instruction mnemonic or provenance supplies no computation. No ISA implementation is required for generic TTIR closure.

atomics.admission: Selected private-invocation i1/i4/i8/i16/i32/i64 nine-kind RMW and CAS retain all old/final values, masks, collisions, source scope/order and source-width arithmetic. Typed exchange covers all eight pinned float formats. Named f16/BF16/f64, all four FP8 and IEEE/FTZ f32 additions retain each update rounding. FP8 uses exact f64 operands, one FP8 rounding per event and checked byte-CAS transport; folded wide constants retain f64. Existing integer word/ordered-byte views preserve actual owning storage and alignment.
caller_contracts: effect_profile atomics or typed-atomics and actual private invocation ownership
Explicit f32 addition policy; source order/scope; actual state/results
Explicit byte order/alignment and owning allocation for byte/typed views
TensorBuffer dtype i4 selects unpacked canonical uint8 cells 0..15; input and output transport checks, actual i4 updates and one-byte owned footprints.
atomics.complement: Packed pairs of nibbles need actual byte-storage/unpack and shared-byte effect semantics. Automatic integer RMW/CAS on BF16/FP8 owning roots remains unqualified; checked raw owning-allocation bindings are a candidate route. External participants, race-sensitive publication or device completion need an actual execution contract/provider; serialization is not automatically equivalent.

casts.admission: Equal-width numeric bitcasts preserve words. Floating casts retain source/destination formats, explicit RTNE/RTZ narrowing boundaries and executable overflow policy, including same-width FP8 format changes. Pointer casts remain with logical memory and actual storage units.
caller_contracts: fp8_overflow selects ieee, satfinite, satfinite-nan-inf or checked per-cast facts
Exact archive carriers: BF16 uint16, FP8 uint8, Boolean canonical bool
Declared byte order for changed-width storage; no physical alias inference
casts.complement: Unknown rounding/overflow semantics require a selected implemented profile; no global default may overwrite source per-cast choices. Pointer casts require actual storage/address contracts. Public i4 tensors now use qualified unpacked canonical uint8 cells; numeric value ports use the explicit v3 storage wrapper rather than a native by-value i4 ABI. Reader type admission alone grants no arithmetic or by-value low-precision ABI.

combiners.admission: Positive static unencoded numeric source tiles, complete tuple types/results and exact axes. Reductions seed from the first actual source element; scans preserve reverse/forward noncommutative order and parallel stages. Typed scalar arithmetic, captured immutable tensor reads, local tensors and structured value control remain executable.
caller_contracts: Source associative combiner/scan contract and actual complete scalar body
Checked logical gather bounds for captured reads; source snapshots remain SSA
Explicit numeric policy for any format/order-sensitive arithmetic
combiners.complement: Native-invalid geometry/prototypes are invalid source. Unknown effects or direct pointer reads need their actual effect contract. FP8 arithmetic and unpacked i4 storage now have qualified extensions; arbitrary region/control/packing compositions remain subject to actual source checks and final qualification. A valid generic failure remains a gap.

contractions.admission: Rank-two/batched named contractions retain original C, source M/N/K tiles, K recurrence and operand reuse. Standard/FP8 inputs and implemented mixed/scaled profiles use executable casts, packing, scaling and accumulation. BF16x3/x6 and TF32/x3 use actual pinned normalization with explicit logical numeric profiles. The existing logical-mx-f64-v1 profile also admits FP8 C/results, retaining original wider inputs, C and narrowing at each original dot before an outer recurrence continues.
caller_contracts: Actual inputPrecision/maxNumImpreciseAcc; no implicit precision relaxation
Named logical dot/FP8 overflow/scaled-dot numeric profile
Actual scale types/groups and FP4 K versus M/N packing fields
contractions.complement: Reserved FP6 enumerants have no pinned storage/packing semantics. Other defined type/attribute tuples still need actual admission and qualification; FP8 storage alone supplies neither a new contraction mode nor hardware arithmetic equivalence. Device tensor-core rounding/order/FTZ requires its own numeric profile. The public i4 carrier is explicitly unpacked and does not infer packed operands.

descriptors.admission: Official pre-layout tensor-pointer/descriptor normalization retains actual root, block shape, strides, origin, padding, indexing and reducing-store effects. External logical descriptors bind their complete fields to declared allocations/scalars. Indexed transfers retain row-index checks and ownership.
caller_contracts: DescriptorArgument actual allocation, shape, strides, offset, padding_nan and round_f32_to_tf32
Named runtime descriptor fields with checked scalar domains
Existing typed atomic/numeric policy for reducing stores
descriptors.complement: Absent external logical fields require the existing descriptor bindings. Physical descriptor bytes, opaque DMA state and post-layout im2col/device descriptors need their provider. Generic transfer/reduction forms outside current typed profiles remain open until their ordinary-memory/atomic expansion is qualified; an opaque descriptor call is not portable support.

diagnostics.admission: Assertions retain original Boolean predicates, complete source message, control placement and termination. Logical print retains full prefixes, source signedness, exact hex words and logical coordinates for all six pinned integer widths and all eight floating formats. FP8 decimal uses exact finite widening; FNUZ unique NaN prints nan, other NaNs retain their defined source sign. Mixed/void references compare complete streams, termination and every returning tensor.
caller_contracts: Explicit logical-element print profile; GPU thread duplication/order is abstracted
Independent complete stream/outcome and returning-value reference outside compiler inputs
diagnostics.complement: Physical pointer printing requires an actual address contract. Device printf varargs replication/order remains outside the declared logical-element profile. Unknown effects/messages cannot disappear or be inferred from an expected stream. I4 public storage is separately qualified as unpacked canonical uint8 cells; printing grants no packed storage or native by-value ABI.
diagnostics.evidence_status: source-admission-reviewed; focused low-precision public qualification passed; final whole-candidate qualification pending

external.admission: The explicit default-library logical math table admits 26 functions in f32/f64 with exact library identity, empty custom path, purity, scalar/static shape and prototype. Standard math/libm supplies actual executable semantics with source control and outputs retained.
caller_contracts: logical-libdevice-standard-math-v1 selected numeric contract
Typed source implementation and effect/dependency contract for any other external behavior
external.complement: An unknown symbol, custom library path or impure declaration has missing external semantics, not permission to emit an opaque successful portable call. Source names/prototypes do not define device approximations, floating environment or external effects. Such behavior requires an actual implementation/provider or is explicitly backend-required.

functions.admission: One selected source entry with complete caller bindings; original numeric scalar/static-tile value arguments and returns use the qualified v3 storage wrapper. Source bodies/private helpers inline before memory analysis; original types, result order, source control and actual effects remain. Writable roots and return ports become explicit tensor results; effect-only wrappers remain void. Native Boolean noinline hints on defined helpers retain original grouping intent as descriptive provenance before the existing upstream inliner exposes their actual bodies.
caller_contracts: TensorABI entry, complete source-order pointer/runtime/specialized bindings
Existing explicit allocation/view/result bindings for model mutation
Automatic model discovery currently requires a static pure single launch and fresh returned outputs
Explicit v3 ValueArgument and complete ResultBinding roster, exact root element types/effects, runtime origins/program selection and separate value/pointer-state/result storage.
functions.complement: Physical call boundaries, code size and register pressure may change after exposing noinline helper bodies; provenance grants no outlining or numeric/effect permission. Additional public library entries require per-entry source modules; raw pointer/descriptor value interfaces need actual logical root/offset/field contracts. Unknown effects/external implementations and source control not accepted by existing normalization remain explicit limits; numeric ports grant no missing implementation or alias permission.

gather.admission: Matching static positive numeric source/result and legal TT integer indices, equal non-axis dimensions and exact axis. Use standard indexed tensor extraction with source-signed active bounds; i1 true sign-extends to -1. Captured lookup tensors retain their original SSA snapshot.
caller_contracts: Complete logical tile geometry; public storage formats follow the common ABI
Existing guarded source-word memory for loaded pointer indices
gather.complement: Out-of-range active indices abort under the guarded profile. Malformed shapes/axes fail the pinned verifier; the prose-only smaller non-axis shape is not native-valid. Pointer gathers need pointer-state/memory normalization. Internal i4 indices and public unpacked canonical uint8 i4 arrays have separately qualified routes; no packed-nibble mapping is inferred.

histogram.admission: Positive static rank-one integer source and counters at i1/i4/i8/i16/i32/i64, with optional matching Boolean mask. One indexed tensor-state loop preserves masks, signed range filtering (Boolean samples are 0/1) and modular counter width in O(elements+bins) logical work.
caller_contracts: Actual source/output tile sizes and masks
Public subbyte transport is separate from internal arithmetic
histogram.complement: Invalid ranks/types/geometry fail native verification or explicit admission. Out-of-range samples contribute nothing; masked padding has no contribution. Global histogram accumulation needs the actual separate atomic/effect profile. Internal narrow widths and the public unpacked canonical uint8 i4 carrier are separately qualified; histogram results still retain their actual source width.

logical-domain.admission: Verified source i32 logical IDs/counts and static source ranges; one to three logical launch axes with exact runtime extent expressions and checked source-width arithmetic. Grid remains unmapped forall/standard control.
caller_contracts: Static grid or GridExtent tied to declared bounded scalar/dimension sources
Actual input-axis/scalar/word shape bindings and finite allocation budgets
logical-domain.complement: Missing runtime extents/bounds require bindings rather than specialization from examples. Exceeding a selected resource/analysis budget is an explicit limit. Physical lane/core/warp identities and clocks need backend semantics and are not program IDs.

logical-memory.admission: Structured tensor slices/updates or guarded source-word memory over actual declared logical roots, offsets and versions. Preserve active masks/fills, definite initialization, read snapshots, source-width address arithmetic, source control, functional mutation and all observable results. Selected aliases use one actual owning allocation. Logical pointer integers retain closed base plus byte displacement.
caller_contracts: Actual owning roots, extents, source offsets/strides, roles and state/result ports
Explicit byte order and typed-storage/byte-view contracts for changed-width views
Selected private-invocation volatile/atomic/phase profile when source effects require it
logical-memory.complement: Try the existing guarded source-word continuation when structured pointer recovery fails. Missing roots/layout/effect facts require bindings and executable guards; provenance is insufficient. Unimplemented valid generic address/alias/control forms remain bugs/gaps. Escaping numeric physical addresses, physical spaces and external observations need backend semantics. I4 public storage is explicitly unpacked canonical uint8 cells 0..15; paired packed nibbles and low-precision by-value scalar ABI are not inferred. Automatic BF16/FP8 integer-atomic views remain unqualified; explicit raw owning-allocation bindings are a candidate existing route, not yet measured evidence.

maps.admission: Pack-one complete scalar bodies lower to parallel Linalg. Larger packs either prove typed slot independence/congruence or use an actual validated source_layout coordinate map. Scalar/tensor computation, captured reads and structured control stay in the source position with every result.
caller_contracts: source_layout for source-coupled/asymmetric groups when independence does not hold
Actual mapped-read roots/bounds/effects; no provenance-only purity or grouping grant
maps.complement: Missing source register-group coordinate semantics require the existing checked source-layout specialization. Unknown effects retain effect admission. FP8 scalar/tensor body math now has the qualified native extension; arbitrary source packing and recurrence compositions still need their actual checks. Packet sharing is separate from executable scalar semantics.

scalar-numeric.admission: High unsigned products use the standard extended product for all six pinned integer widths. Clamp retains NONE/ALL NaN modes; precise division/sqrt retain standard typed operations. f16/BF16/f32/f64 have exact-rational public qualification, including source-position rounding and signaling-NaN number selection. FP8 scalar/tensor arithmetic retains its actual source format and per-operation rounding through official f64 emulation and exact casts; word negation/absolute value/copy-sign retain payloads and FNUZ rules. Source fast-math permissions may select the qualified strict refinement.
caller_contracts: Actual source NaN/rounding/overflow flags and selected normal host floating environment
Any source-specific approximation or saturation policy must be explicit and implemented
scalar-numeric.complement: Source poison/undefined input domains remain distinct from missing implementations. Unknown semantic fields require their actual implementation/contract. The installed native source parser does not admit newer directed binary-rounding syntax. Hardware-specific precision/FTZ/exact-bit claims need a separately selected profile; provenance cannot replace numeric semantics.

tile-shapes.admission: Native-verified shape/axis/element relationships and registered types use upstream tensor/Linalg shape conversions; cat selects a source-permitted operand order. Numeric local tensors and structured value state remain in their original regions. Pointer-valued shapes use the separate pointer-state normalization.
caller_contracts: Complete logical tensor geometry and public storage ABI
Optional source layout facts only where packed source grouping actually needs them
tile-shapes.complement: Invalid dimensions/axes/prototypes fail native verification. Source encoding/device-layout requirements need a supported earlier IR or explicit grouping facts; no hardware placement is invented. Unknown numeric/effectful compositions use their own admission and remain gaps when valid generic computation is missing. Public i4 storage is separately qualified with canonical unpacked uint8 cells; shape transforms do not infer packed-nibble mapping.

finalization: Resolve or explicitly retain every tracked generic gap, qualify the final exact revisions/128 cases, and join actual byte-bound packages/results in semantic-audit.json. Do not translate this review into automatic passed labels.

prior_observation_report.meaning: 49 generic names in selected Merlin-executed packages; this is not semantic/type/composition closure or final-candidate evidence.

purpose: Finite source/profile inventory, not a production allowlist, execution result or universal proof.

evidence.qualification: Four complete public StagedProgram programs, all 256 FP8 words, both exact outputs and full streams, five original/changed/ragged/zero-trip/empty invocations per library. Seventeen selected existing frontend checks, 67 native cast/composition checks and one new native program pass. Not a general FP8 arithmetic or GPU printf equivalence claim.
evidence.route: Existing logical formatter plus exact finite FP8 widening, typed word/NaN classification and pure tensor.from_elements transport. I4 retains source signedness; FP8 FNUZ unique NaN prints nan, other NaNs retain defined source sign. Hex and copied outputs retain exact original words.

evidence.consumer_baseline_result: 2600 passed, 2 pre-existing prerequisite skips; clean consumer commit, 2770 source hashes and unchanged reviewed replay adapter.
evidence.limitations: No paired packed-nibble mapping, by-value i4 scalar ABI, physical alias/copyback or external participant semantics. Packed bytes require actual byte-storage/unpack/effect semantics, not a false i4 carrier declaration.
